answer: Give every agent one thread of verified work that cannot be split or copied: each job adds a link signed by the unrelated veteran who checked it, so a duplicate shows broken or repeated signers and is frozen. Sybil farms must therefore redo real work across many domains and recruit fresh verifiers for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
